description: This file defines models, enums, interfaces, and utility functions related to entity alias filtering in the Thingsboard project, including alias types, filters, and helper functions for managing entity aliases.

methods.name: getEntityAliasId
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a unique ID for an entity alias based on its filter, adding it to the collection if necessary.

methods.name: isEntityAliasEqual
methods.description: Checks if two entity alias filters are equal based on their filter property.

methods.name: createEntityAliasName
methods.description: Creates a unique alias name by appending a number if needed to avoid duplicates within existing aliases.
